meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: after the queue is knocked out — the orchestration node; the mandala egg becomes a working chat window

orchestration_node.law: THE EGG SPEAKS. The mandala is not a place with a chat panel in it — the mandala IS the chat window.

design.orchestration_node: a new node — the speech center of the organism (its Broca's area). It assembles utterances; it does not author them alone.
design.small_agents: words driven by small agents: transmitter-agents carry word-fragments between neurons, the way blood carries oxygen and signals cross synapses. Each fragment is carried, not generated in isolation.
design.assembly: pieced together similar to a human mind: fragments converge on the orchestration node and are assembled into language — many small carriers, one coherent voice.
design.language_shell: the words draw from the 28 language nodes of the outer shell — the genesis layer becomes the vocabulary.

orchestration_node.honest_boundary: the assembly must be real — fragments actually carried and actually assembled — not canned responses wearing an agent costume. Until the controlled external runtime exists, the chat labels what it is (Mira templates), exactly as the current build does.
orchestration_node.queue: NEXT MILESTONE after the current queue is finished and verified. Not dispatched until then — Nathan's build discipline: knock out what we have first.
